production_owner_confirmation: After the owner explicitly confirms the production identity, verify the exact production Auth issuer and subject (Supabase user UUID), find their users.auth_issuer + users.auth_subject mapping, and set REXBID_OWNER_USER_ID to the resulting RexBid D1 users.id. Never use a Supabase UUID as the application owner ID without that mapping. Never infer ownership from signup order, email likeness or a staging identity. Enroll a separate production MFA factor. Keep staging MFA unchanged.

recovery_policy.cross_browser: Recovery does not depend on the request browser's PKCE flow cookie. The browser opening the email gets only the restricted recovery cookie; OTP verification occurs on explicit same-origin password POST.

www_policy.action: Cloudflare redirect before Worker routing; preserve path and query, redirect GET/HEAD permanently, reject unsafe mutations on the alias. Do not add www to Auth origins or Supabase Site URL.

smtp.reply_to_notes: Apply only where the Supabase SMTP/template UI supports reply-to; contact forwarding remains at OVH.
smtp.production_key_policy: Separate Resend Sending access API key limited to powiadomienia.rexbid.pl, supplied directly to production Supabase SMTP Password. Never copy staging SMTP credentials or record key values here.
smtp.sender_and_username_evidence: OWNER_REPORTED_EXACT_VALUES; tool redacted sender email and username fields

activation_phases.owner_setup: Auth and portal schema gate ON after separate approval; files OFF, no R2 binding; owner enrolls MFA, administrative operations still require verified AAL2
activation_phases.portal: Full profile only after production owner MFA, SMTP confirmation/recovery E2E, private R2 verification and verified global free-usage controls covering storage plus Class A/Class B operations; alerts alone are insufficient. Files remain OFF if those controls are unavailable. No staging data transfer.

required_limiter_config.namespace_scope: bound_to_private_candidate_only; recheck before approved production binding

supabase_redirect_notes: Site URL must equal production origin. BFF confirmation/OAuth callback uses dynamic state query and the exact path allowlist with state wildcard. Production recovery template must use SiteURL + TokenHash rather than ConfirmationURL; it creates only a restricted grant. Do not add broad /** patterns, www or staging origins.
